page.overview:
Who is Senri Ubuyashiki?

As a child, Senri looked identical to his brothers, with the only differences being a different colored kimono and his bangs being parted down the middle. In addition, he was shown to wear an angered glare and had bags under his eyes, reflecting his resentful personality.

Unlike the kind and understanding Kagaya or meek and docile Akito, Senri was volatile and resentful, intensely loathing his family curse giving him a shortened life. He also hated his family's custom of donning female attire to stave off the curse, possibly out of a feeling of emasculation. Senri's hatred of his cursed life worsened when his father committed suicide, and he eventually would retaliate by setting his home on fire to commit suicide himself, taking his younger brother in doing so.

Senri was the middle child of his generation of the Ubuyashiki family. He lamented his short life span and refused to wear female clothing, as was tradition in the Ubuyashiki family to stall the familiar curse. He also gradually lost his mental balance from fear. After the suicide of his father, he spent his days cursing his mother and older brother. Eventually, Senri took his younger brother, Akito, to set fire to the mansion, and forced him to commit double suicide. Their mother would die from the fire in an attempt to save them, leaving Kagaya to be the sole survivor.
